description: Bowtie Risk Visual draws bow-tie risk diagrams from the risk register you already have in Power BI. No separate tool, no re-keying, no drawing by hand. Causes on the left flow through prevention barriers to the top event, then through mitigation barriers to consequences on the right. Barrier groups collapse to a summary card — count, health dots, open and overdue actions — and expand to individual barriers on a click. The risk score badge takes its colour from your own risk matrix. Two views, one dataset. Risk Bowtie shows one risk in full. Barrier View puts a barrier at the centre and shows every risk, cause and consequence it protects across your whole portfolio — for barrier owners managing safety-critical elements that appear in a dozen bow-ties. Free Risk Bowtie in the Grouped layout, with expand/collapse barrier groups Health, action and overdue counts on every barrier and on the risk Hover tooltips Premium (one-month free trial) Vertical and auto layouts, with pan, zoom and path highlighting Barrier View Click any node for a detail panel with linked actions; titles link straight to your risk platform if you supply a URL Cross-filter other visuals; drill through to your own detail pages Full colour, font and toolbar customisation More than 100 users?
